mapper.insert: INSERT INTO nw_system_agent_create_receipts(request_id,actor_ref,request_fingerprint) VALUES(CAST(#{requestId} AS uuid),#{actor},#{fingerprint}) ON CONFLICT (request_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE nw_system_agent_create_receipts SET agent_id=CAST(#{agentId} AS bigint) WHERE request_id=CAST(#{requestId} AS uuid) AND agent_id IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT actor_ref,request_fingerprint AS fingerprint,agent_id::text AS agent_id FROM nw_system_agent_create_receipts WHERE request_id=CAST(#{requestId} AS uuid)
